officer_appointments_current_ended_chk.name: officer_appointments_current_ended_chk
officer_appointments_current_ended_chk.value: ("officer_appointments"."is_current" = true AND "officer_appointments"."ended_at" IS NULL) OR ("officer_appointments"."is_current" = false AND "officer_appointments"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)

events_published_meta_chk.name: events_published_meta_chk
events_published_meta_chk.value: "events"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' OR ("events"."published_by" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

events_completed_meta_chk.name: events_completed_meta_chk
events_completed_meta_chk.value: "events"."status" <> 'COMPLETED' OR ("events"."completed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

documents_single_parent_chk.name: documents_single_parent_chk
documents_single_parent_chk.value: NOT ("documents"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."meeting_id" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_committee_requires_event_chk.name: tasks_committee_requires_event_chk
tasks_committee_requires_event_chk.value: "tasks"."committee_id" IS NULL OR "tasks"."event_id" IS NOT NULL

attendance_checkpoints_xor_parent_chk.name: attendance_checkpoints_xor_parent_chk
attendance_checkpoints_xor_parent_chk.value: ("attendance_checkpoints"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_checkpoints"."meeting_id" IS NULL) OR ("attendance_checkpoints"."event_id" IS NULL AND "attendance_checkpoints"."meeting_id" IS NOT NULL)

attendance_checkpoints_window_chk.name: attendance_checkpoints_window_chk
attendance_checkpoints_window_chk.value: "attendance_checkpoints"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "attendance_checkpoints"."closes_at" IS NULL OR "attendance_checkpoints"."closes_at" >= "attendance_checkpoints"."opens_at"

attendance_records_edit_reason_chk.name: attendance_records_edit_reason_chk
attendance_records_edit_reason_chk.value: ("attendance_records"."last_edited_by" IS NULL AND "attendance_records"."recorded_via" = 'QR_SCAN') OR ("attendance_records"."edit_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("attendance_records"."edit_reason")) > 0)

announcements_published_meta_chk.name: announcements_published_meta_chk
announcements_published_meta_chk.value: "announcements"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' OR ("announcements"."published_by" IS NOT NULL AND "announcements"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
